scope: prospective canonical-ct-v1 helper and collector callsites; no model, GPU, tool invocation, or old sample mutation

reviewed_paths.history_copy_on_write: JSON copies; caller inputs not modified
reviewed_paths.history_hashes: transition hash computed before adding itself; after-history hash only in returned metadata; no self-cycle
reviewed_paths.binding_errors: independent HistoryBindingError; template/tools/source mismatch fatal while active
reviewed_paths.prefix_restore: exact prefix rendered at episode entry before active canonical sampling; pre-action call checked again
reviewed_paths.call_ids: vfarl_turn_{ledger.turns:06d}; actual turn increment precedes call append and snapshots preserve ledger
reviewed_paths.nudge_budget: shallow candidate ledger updated only after suffix/context room accepted; helper deep-copies history
reviewed_paths.fallback: Unsupported preserves actual completion and uses raw suffix from the currently conditioned prefix; no previous raw transcript reconstruction

confirmed_edge.description: Actual strict NativeArguments accepts overflowing exponent into nonfinite float, but same supplied parsed arguments are classified as caller binding failure before rendering. In live collector tool exceptions otherwise return real error response and continue; canonical helper can instead abort that sample.
confirmed_edge.suggested_minimal_boundary: Keep legacy parser/behavior unchanged; classify valid caller-strict generated argument JSON-domain overflow as Unsupported rather than template/state Binding. Root must decide implementation; no source changed here.

nonblocking_boundary.inactive_fallback_source_pin: episode only calls require_canonical_prefix for active history; after explicit permanent raw fallback history helper is unused. If source binding is intended fatal even after fallback, check helper source SHA separately. No confirmed behavior or probability corruption.

limits: This is an actual parser/helper synthetic input mechanism, not an observed model rollout or real tool failure.
No claim of official HTTP/vLLM equivalence or model/reward benefit.
No dedicated tests or validation scripts added.
